submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, grounded running sprite correction. Edit image 1, keep the same boy, exact head size, costume, face, camera and canvas placement. Images2–3 are identity/direction; image4 is approved art style; image5 is only the under-hip support-leg mechanics reference.
RUN SW frame07: first pose of an eight-frame continuous RIGHT-foot ground-support interval. The RIGHT/far foot must land almost directly UNDER THE PELVIS, not out in front. Redraw the connected right thigh, knee, ankle and shoe. Bring the current foreground shoe toward screen-right under his right hip: in the 1024 reference coordinate system the supporting ankle is approximately x520, with shoe contact around y940, rather than the existing shoe reaching far toward x380. The knee is directly above that ankle with a soft bend; the right hip and belly sit over the planted shoe. Both heel and forefoot contact the virtual ground; shoe toe still points lower-left, same southwest direction as knee and shin. Never turn the sole toward the viewer or roll the ankle outward.
The anatomical LEFT/near leg remains behind with its knee folded and shoe airborne. The near LEFT arm holds the bell forward; far RIGHT arm holds FIVE red cards behind. Preserve both complete arm chains and all five cards. Only two legs.
Natural body articulation, no moving/scaling the whole cutout. No floor, shadow or effects. Transparent RGBA single full square sprite native at least1024.
